name: Death & Starting Over
summary: What happens when you die, and how to begin again.

sections.heading: Death
sections.body: There is no ghost state. When you die, you simply respawn. Eating a [[heart]] grants one extra life against a lethal attack.

sections.heading: Changing race
sections.body:
- A [[human-potion]] turns you back into a Human.
- The [[save-progress-pass]] lets you swap race and keep your levels.
- Becoming a [[cannibal-raised-vampire]] resets your level.

sections.heading: Recovering data
sections.body: `/recoverydata` searches back 14 days, and the team-swap log keeps your level in the right slot.
